name: Mandatory reviewer-agent rules
summary: Rules such as "always run a reviewer after edits". Not offered by setup; offered as a bench arm. A review stage took 59.4% of tokens in one multi-agent system and no paired gain was found. Targeted checks are the simpler alternative.

evidence.source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.14470 (Tokenomics: Quantifying Where Tokens Are Used in Agentic Software Engineering)
evidence.setting: ChatDev, a multi-agent system; measures where tokens go, not the effect of a reviewer rule
evidence.effect: A review stage took 59.4% of tokens

maintenance: Owned text, written only if a bench arm needs it.
